destination: A locked happy-path baseline for example-app on canary, then error and adversarial tiers for draft editing.
notes: Drive the app with the Playwright MCP browser tools; the product has no Playwright install of its own.
fog: Error paths for each capability (after the baseline is locked).
Adversarial scenarios for each capability (after the baseline is locked).
outOfScope: Billing: the user ruled payments out of this effort.

charters.name: Set up the QA effort
charters.mission: Name the destination with the user and confirm environments, identities, issue storage, coverage and the mutation policy.
charters.gist: Canary, guest plus owner and member, local issue drafts, owned fixtures only.

charters.name: Find every route
charters.mission: List every route of the app from its source and a crawl per identity, then charter one inventory per route.
charters.gist: 3 routes: 2 to inventory, the admin console unreachable without an admin identity.

charters.name: Inventory the draft editor
charters.mission: Find and operate every interactive element on /drafts/:id as owner.

charters.name: Inventory sign up
charters.mission: Find and operate every interactive element on /sign-up as guest.

charters.name: Group routes into capabilities
charters.mission: Write one map.json path per capability, linked to its routes; then charter an intent and a happy-scenarios charter for each.
